Keywords of QTrans_prep

Structure of the input data

We use a yaml file as the input configuration. For different prep_mode values, the program requires different input blocks. However, the parameters in basic block must always be defined in the input file. The format is as follows:

baisc:
    prep_mode: <prep_mode>
    outdir: <outdir>

block_name1:
    key1: value1
    key2: value2

block_name2:
    key3: value3
    key4: value4

Keywords

Blocks

Block <basic>:

prep_mode, outdir

Block <software_path>:

vasp_path, vaspkit_path, vasp_pot_dir, openmx_path, openmx_pp_path, openmx_read_path, openmx_dftdata_dir, abacus_path, abacus_pp_path, jx_path

Block <material>:

struct_path, std_symm_cell, symm_tol, magnetic_tolerance, magnetic_type, soc_switch, DFT_software, nao_max

Block <scf_params>:

scf_uc_kpt, scf_rec_density

Block <grad_epc>:

dSon_delta_r, grad_sparse_thr, epc_sc_matrix, epc_sc_auto_length, epc_sc_disp, graph_data_sc_path, pred_H_sc_path, mat_info_sc_path, use_prediction

Block <graph_pack>:

HSout_filename, nonscf_filename, stdin_filename, vbout_filename, data_folder, converge_step_ratio,

Back to top

DFT_software
Options: 'openmx' | 'abacus' | 'siesta'
Default: None

Selects the DFT software associated with the input data and generated files.

  • openmx: OpenMX interface.

  • abacus: ABACUS interface.

  • siesta: SIESTA basis definitions are listed in Atomic Orbital Basis Definition, but the current preparer input validation does not yet accept this option.

Use openmx or abacus for the preparation workflows documented here.

material

Back to top

nao_max
Options: 13 | 14 | 15 | 19 | 26 | 27 | 40
Default: 26

Determines which predefined atomic orbital basis set to use, based on the specified integer value and DFT_software. The basis set is specified as {DFT_software}_{nao_max}. More details can be found in Input Keywords/Atomic Orbital Basis Definition.

Atomic Orbital Basis

openmx_14

OpenMX basis set specifying a maximum of 14 orbitals per element

openmx_19

OpenMX basis set specifying a maximum of 19 orbitals per element

openmx_26

OpenMX basis set specifying a maximum of 26 orbitals per element

siesta_13

SIESTA basis set specifying a maximum of 13 orbitals per element

siesta_19

SIESTA basis set specifying a maximum of 19 orbitals per element

abacus_13

ABACUS basis set specifying a maximum of 13 orbitals per element

abacus_15

ABACUS basis set specifying a maximum of 15 orbitals per element

abacus_27

ABACUS basis set specifying a maximum of 27 orbitals per element

abacus_40

ABACUS basis set specifying a maximum of 40 orbitals per element

scf_params block

scf_uc_kpt
Options: 'auto' | *LIST[INT, INT, INT]*
Default: 'auto'

The size of the reciprocal-space k-point sampling grid. If set to 'auto', the grid will be automatically generated based on scf_rec_density.

scf params

Back to top

scf_rec_density
Options: *FLOAT*
Default: 50.0

The reciprocal-space k-point sampling density for SCF calculations, specified in units of [angstrom]. If scf_uc_kpt is 'auto', the k-point grid will be generated based on this value and the lattice constants.

scf params

Back to top

grad_epc block

dSon_delta_r
Options: *FLOAT*
Default: 0.001

Small displacement (in angstroms) applied to compute the gradient of onsite overlap matrix elements.

grad epc

Back to top

grad_sparse_thr
Options: *FLOAT*
Default: 0.0001

The threshold (in Hartree/bohr) below which elements in the sparse gradient matrix are neglected.

grad epc

Back to top

epc_sc_matrix
Options: 'auto' | *LIST[INT, INT, INT]*
Default: 'auto'

The supercell size used for EPC gradient matrix calculation. Note that all three integers must be odd. If set to 'auto', the supercell size will be automatically determined based on epc_sc_auto_length.

grad epc

Back to top

epc_sc_auto_length
Options: *FLOAT*
Default: 10.0

If epc_sc_matrix is set to 'auto', the supercell size required for EPC gradient matrix calculation will be automatically determined using this value, specified in angstroms.

grad epc

Back to top

epc_sc_disp
Options: *FLOAT*
Default: 0.01

Small displacement (in angstroms) used to compute the gradient of the Hamiltonian for EPC calculation, using the finite displacement method.

grad epc

Back to top

graph_data_sc_path
Options: *STRING*
Default: None

Path to the graph data of supercells used to compute the Hamiltonian gradient for EPC calculation, using the finite displacement method.

grad epc

Back to top

pred_H_sc_path
Options: *STRING*
Default: None

Path to the prediction Hamiltonian of supercells used to compute the Hamiltonian gradient for EPC calculation, using the finite displacement method. Used only if use_prediction is True.

grad epc

Back to top

mat_info_sc_path
Options: *STRING*
Default: None

Path to the mat_info_sc.npy file generated by QTrans. It should contain the mapping between unit cell and supercells used to compute the Hamiltonian gradient for EPC calculation, using the finite displacement method.

grad epc

Back to top

use_prediction
Options: True | False
Default: False

If True, the program reads the Hamiltonians from pred_H_sc_path instead of from graph_data_sc_path. However, it still requires other information from graph_data_sc_path.

grad epc

Back to top

graph_pack block

HSout_filename
Options: None | *STRING*
Default: None

Specifies the name of the file containing the self-consistent Hamiltonian and overlap matrix. If set to None, the graph data will be constructed using non-self-consistent part of Hamiltonian, which requires stdin_filename and nonscf_filename. Otherwise, the graph data will be built using self-consistent Hamiltonian inside this file and also other information from vbout_filename. In this case, non-self-consistent part of Hamiltonian data can also be included by specifying nonscf_filename.

graph pack

Back to top

nonscf_filename
Options: None | *STRING*
Default: None

The name of the file that contains the non-self-consistent Hamiltonian and overlap matrix.

graph pack

Back to top

stdin_filename
Options: None | *STRING*
Default: None

The name of the DFT software input file. Has no effect unless HSout_filename is None.

graph pack

Back to top

vbout_filename
Options: None | *STRING*
Default: None

The name of the DFT software output file. Has no effect unless HSout_filename is not None.

graph pack

Back to top

data_folder
Options: *STRING*
Default: None

Specifies the directories of the folders with the raw data to be packed into graph data. This path will be used by the glob.glob() function to match all directories. Note that this value must point to the directory of folders, not files.

graph pack

Back to top

converge_step_ratio
Options: *FLOAT*
Default: 0.9

Defines the maximum acceptable ratio between the number of self-consistent field (SCF) steps actually taken to reach convergence and the maximum number of SCF steps specified in the DFT input settings. Data entries with a convergence ratio exceeding this threshold will be excluded from the graph data generation process.

graph pack
